Removes 100% more plaque compared to a manual toothbrush and experience healthier gums for a visibly improved smile in just one week. Intelligent features like the iO Pressure Sensor alert you if you brush too hard, too soft, or just right. With three visible brushing modes - cleaning, sensitive, whitening, - you can customize your brushing experience to meet your specific dental needs. The unique round brush head and Tuft-inTuft bristle technology coupled with micro-vibrations leave your mouth feeling fresh and clean. Enjoy the assurance of a 2-year warranty and embrace superior oral care from Oral-B, the #1 brand recommended by dentists worldwide. Its IXP7 waterproof technology makes it absolutely waterproof and safe to use. Oral B iO3 is compatible with iO electric toothbrush replacement heads of any colour.
